choices: Chromosomes line up at the cell equator for the first time
DNA is replicated
Sister chromatids separate and move toward opposite poles
Nuclear envelopes reform around chromosomes
questions.explain: Anaphase distributes identical chromatids to opposite sides of the cell.
choice_explanations: Incorrect. That occurs during metaphase.
Incorrect. Replication occurs earlier in S phase.
Correct. Anaphase is defined by chromatid separation.
Incorrect. That is characteristic of telophase.

questions.text: A graph shows that increasing ligand concentration increases response up to a plateau. Which conclusion is most likely?
choices: The ligand destroys all receptors at high concentration
The pathway no longer requires receptors
Cell signaling stops because ATP disappears from the organism
Receptors become saturated at high ligand concentrations
questions.explain: A plateau in response often indicates receptor saturation.
choice_explanations: Incorrect. A plateau alone does not indicate destruction.
Incorrect. The plateau occurs because receptors are central and become limiting.
Incorrect. The graph supports saturation more directly.
Correct. Once most receptors are occupied, additional ligand has little additional effect.
